banned.why: every random number comes from a seed: Rng / deriveSeed (@futuremagic/core)
one renderer, made in one place (createRenderer)
workers are created by the one worker pool
every material is a kind in the registry, so warm-up knows every shader (docs/SHADERS.md)
shader variants come from the registry's TSL kinds, not from patched source (docs/SHADERS.md)
compiling is the Stage's job: warmUp() and add() (docs/SHADERS.md)

layers.why: the generator is pure data: it runs in workers and headless tests
world queries are pure: gameplay, workers and tests use them
creatures are pure simulation: the game draws them, tests run them
combat is pure rules: anyone who fights uses them
the renderer does not know about the Lab or the game
the game does not depend on the Lab (shared setup lives in src/render and src/app)
input is plain DOM: both the Lab and the game read it
